messages.author: 6c045cbdd3be3206
messages.subject: Error extracting tags with DigiKam 7.1.0.
parts:
Hello

I´m using camtrapR softwer 2.0.3 and R 4.0.2. Before I used Digikam 6.4.0 in windows 10 (32win), I extracted all tags correctely, but Digikam had problems and I changed for new version Digikam 7.1.0 and right now, I can´t extract tags with camtrapR.

Has anyone else had this problem and knows how to fix it?
thank you very much for your help

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Error extracting tags with DigiKam 7.1.0.
parts:
Hi Mari,
I'm afraid I'll need some more details to help you:

- what problems did digiKam have before your update?
- are we talking about photos or videos?
- in the new version of digiKam, do the tags show up correctly with the images?
- what are the error messages you get, and with which function (please also provide the code of the function that failed)?
- can you extract image tags with exifTagNames(), and is the HierarchicalSubject tag present and correct in the output?

Thank you very much for the clarification.
Best,
Jürgen

messages.author: 6c045cbdd3be3206
messages.subject: Re: [camtrapR] Re: Error extracting tags with DigiKam 7.1.0.
parts:
Excuse me. I have already found the problem. In my case, Digikam was installed incorrectly, which is why it marked the labels but did not save them as metadata. CamtrapR does not present any errors. To solve it you have to go to Preferences, Configure Digikam, and in Metadata mark the first seven configurations and update the file modification date. In this way the metadata can be saved. For the photos that we had already tagged I have not found a solution together, I have saved one by one updating the tags. Hope I can help with the comment if someone else did this. And thank you very much for the help in the forum.

Greetings
